name: M15 trend-plus-pullback continuation and failure screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen legacy backlog cites an unspecified edition at pages 418, 835 and 950 for pullback-with-trend context
source_references.supports: Wiley verifies current bibliographic metadata only. The cited legacy pages were not opened and provide no direct cost-aware M15 FX result; they motivate only the general pullback territory.

research.evidence_summary: No inspected source establishes this compact M15 FX rule. The frozen legacy backlog supplies only book-level pullback context, so the symmetric continuation-versus-failure specification is original, speculative, and low-prior.

feasibility.rationale: The rule uses only supported M1 OHLC, causal contiguous M15 bars, signal-close fills, one fixed ATR stop and same-day exits; V2 still must confirm isolated cell/result transport.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes through signal t; elapsed gaps do not reset ATR, but every event bar t-P-8 through t must be physically adjacent
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require exactly 15 consecutive unique valid M1 candles per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates are invalid before aggregation
Compute observed-sequence TR using previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from the first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, and freeze ATR through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: An eight-bar net move is not an independently established trend regime
A one/two-bar pullback can be random sign noise
Six correlated symbols and eight cells are not independent trials
No development result authorizes final-holdout access

hypothesis.behavior: After an ATR-material eight-change directional move ending before a one- or two-change strict pullback, price may resume the prior direction or continue with the pullback.
hypothesis.mechanism: Resumption may reflect staggered trend-following flow; failure may reflect exhaustion of the preceding move and the start of reversal.
works_when: The prior move is material and the pullback is orderly across contiguous bars
One response sign survives both pullback lengths and adjacent holding periods after costs
fails_when: The trend label is retrospective path fitting
Pullbacks do not predict beyond unconditional serial dependence
falsifiable_predictions: A response-mode center and at least one exact neighbor have positive net R
The center is positive in both UTC-midpoint halves and at least three symbols
The center and required neighbor survive doubled costs and five-date removal

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) over valid observed M15 true ranges through t-1, using previous observed close across elapsed gaps
definitions.timing: Frozen at signal close; require finite and positive

definitions.name: trend_direction
definitions.timing: Uses eight completed close changes ending immediately before the P-change pullback

definitions.name: pullback_valid
definitions.timing: Uses exactly P completed strict opposite close changes

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: trend_direction for RESUMPTION and -trend_direction for FAILURE

entries.long_condition: eligible t AND trend_displacement_ratio>=1.0 AND pullback_valid AND ((trend_direction=+1 AND response_mode=RESUMPTION) OR (trend_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FAILURE)) AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible t AND trend_displacement_ratio>=1.0 AND pullback_valid AND ((trend_direction=-1 AND response_mode=RESUMPTION) OR (trend_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FAILURE)) AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of a London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on a weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes is no later than 15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at the final M1 chart/bid close of completed M15 bar t; V2 separately applies resolved or fixed-fallback spread, commission and slippage. The entry candle cannot trigger the new stop; management begins next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or reset from overlapping events
Every event bar t-P-8 through t is physically adjacent
Equal close changes invalidate the affected trend direction or pullback

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers on bid, short on executable ask; adverse gaps fill at V2's worse executable open with all costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at the M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; on a valid due bar STOP_LOSS precedes TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry may mature after 15:00 London; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns an isolated portfolio. Within a cell, same-timestamp symbols size from one common pre-entry equity snapshot so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell: at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap is shared across eight portfolios
risk.leverage: Use the lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol and six total; all eight cells have independent positions, equity, exposure, overlap and failures

experiment.baseline: pullback_changes=1, response_mode=RESUMPTION, holding_minutes=60, fixed trend_changes=8, displacement=1 ATR and stop=1 ATR
robustness_tests: Report all eight cells and retain the complete contemporaneous breadth ledger
Report every symbol and UTC-midpoint development half; a close exactly at midpoint belongs to the first half
Multiply spread, commission and slippage individually by two
For each response-mode center P=1/hold=60, remove its five best normal-cost London dates from the center and exact neighbors P=2 and hold=30; require retained normal/doubled net R positive
For each center and neighbor use eligible London weekdays including zeros and 10000 circular five-date block-bootstrap resamples with seed 2026011; center normal-cost lower bound must exceed zero
A mode advances only if its center and at least one of the two exact neighbors P=2 or hold=30 passes every gate
costs: Use resolved or frozen-fallback spread, commission and slippage at every fill
Double each cost component for stress
No swap because all exits precede 15:00 London
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical events
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 296 selectable R007-R011 cells, R008's two diagnostics, and every named legacy trial including I-05 pullback variants. Any cross-batch comparison or promotion uses the complete ledger. Incomplete historical IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell or best-family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject a mode unless center and at least one exact neighbor are positive after normal/doubled costs
Reject if center is non-positive in either UTC half or fewer than three symbols are positive in each half
Reject if center has fewer than 200 pooled trades
Reject if five-date removal makes center or required neighbor non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
Reject promotion if required cells fail data integrity
Never access final holdout without explicit authorization for a separately frozen promoted version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
Maintain observed-sequence Wilder ATR(96) through t-1.
For P=1/2 calculate the preceding eight-change direction/displacement and require P strict opposite changes.
Map resumption/failure and enter flat cells at signal close.
From next M1 process stop before due exit and fail only affected cells on defects.
Publish eight cells, neighbors, robustness and full breadth-ledger identities.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: event-window gap suppresses signal while elapsed gaps remain in ATR
adverse gap uses worse executable open
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with shared features and isolated eight-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 M15/fill/cell-state compatibility and confirmation of required result rows
